knownDifferences.name: float32.arith
knownDifferences.difference: `float32` is a JavaScript number, so it keeps double precision instead of rounding to single.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use `float`, or a Float32Array from WebSharper.JavaScript when single-precision storage matters.

knownDifferences.name: recursion.deep.nontail
knownDifferences.code: let rec f n = if n = 0 then 0 else 1 + f (n - 1) in string (f 10000)
knownDifferences.difference: JavaScript has a fixed call stack, so deep non-tail recursion overflows sooner than on .NET.
knownDifferences.alternative: Write the function tail-recursive (WebSharper turns self tail calls into loops), or use a loop or a fold.

knownDifferences.name: string.equality
knownDifferences.difference: JavaScript strings are values: two equal strings are never different references.

knownDifferences.name: equals.boxed
knownDifferences.difference: Numbers are not boxed with their .NET type in JavaScript: `box 1` and `box 1.0` are the same value.
knownDifferences.alternative: Compare unboxed values of a known type.

knownDifferences.name: match.typetest.float.int
knownDifferences.difference: `int` and `float` are both JavaScript numbers, so `:? int` cannot tell a whole-number `float` from an `int`.
knownDifferences.alternative: Keep the static type, or use a union case per numeric type.

knownDifferences.name: match.typetest.char.string
knownDifferences.difference: A `char` is a one-character JavaScript string, so `:? string` also matches a boxed `char`.
knownDifferences.alternative: Keep the static type, or use a union case per type.

knownDifferences.name: string.index.out.of.range
knownDifferences.difference: String indexing is not bounds-checked: reading past the end gives undefined instead of throwing IndexOutOfRangeException.

knownDifferences.name: exception.nullref
knownDifferences.code: let s : string = null in string s.Length
knownDifferences.difference: Dereferencing null throws a JavaScript TypeError, not a NullReferenceException.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use options or check with `isNull` instead of catching NullReferenceException.

knownDifferences.name: option.value.prop
knownDifferences.difference: `None` is null, so `.Value` on it throws a JavaScript TypeError, not a NullReferenceException.
knownDifferences.alternative: Match on the option, or use Option.defaultValue.

knownDifferences.name: dictionary.union.key
knownDifferences.code: let d = Dictionary<int option, int>() in d.[Some 1] <- 5; d.[None] <- 6; string d.[Some 1] + string d.[None]
knownDifferences.difference: `None` is null, which .NET rejects as a Dictionary key; JavaScript accepts it.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use `Map`, or a key type without a null case.

knownDifferences.name: datetime.format.iso
knownDifferences.difference: A DateTime has no Kind in JavaScript: the "o" format writes local time with its offset.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use DateTimeOffset, or Date.toISOString from WebSharper.JavaScript for a UTC timestamp.

knownDifferences.name: decimal.add
knownDifferences.difference: `decimal` is implemented by the WebSharper.MathJS package, not by the standard library.

knownDifferences.name: decimal.divide
knownDifferences.difference: `decimal` is implemented by the WebSharper.MathJS package, not by the standard library.

knownDifferences.name: sprintf.M
knownDifferences.difference: `decimal` is implemented by the WebSharper.MathJS package, not by the standard library.

knownDifferences.name: typeof.name
knownDifferences.difference: No reflection: System.Type is not available in JavaScript, and a partial typeof<T>.Name would suggest otherwise.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use `nameof` for names, or WebSharper.JavaScript.Object.GetPrototypeOf for the JavaScript prototype.

knownDifferences.name: typeof.int.name
knownDifferences.difference: No reflection: System.Type is not available in JavaScript, and a partial typeof<T>.Name would suggest otherwise.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use `nameof` for names, or WebSharper.JavaScript.Object.GetPrototypeOf for the JavaScript prototype.

knownDifferences.name: gettype.name
knownDifferences.difference: No reflection: GetType() is not available in JavaScript.
knownDifferences.alternative: Use `nameof` for names, `:?` patterns for type tests, or WebSharper.JavaScript.Object.GetPrototypeOf for the JavaScript prototype.

knownDifferences.name: enum.parse
knownDifferences.difference: No reflection: Enum.Parse takes a System.Type, which is not available in JavaScript.
knownDifferences.alternative: Match the string against the enum's cases instead.
